method: Compare shadows-disabled samples with previous shadows/validation.json, same scenes and eight-hop workload. Separate app launches; thermal/scheduling noise is not controlled, so frame intervals are indicative. Both disabled passes are weighted by sample count; idle and startup capture excluded.
triangleScope: 3D triangle-list instances loaded for this view, including complete parent, current scene and child LOD; excludes GUI and additional shadow-pass submissions. Shared meshes count once per instance. inFrustum counts whole meshes intersecting the engine camera sphere/frustum test, not pixel-visible or occlusion-tested triangles. The engine spatial-index AABB broad phase can additionally reject meshes; inFrustum is a conservative sphere-based diagnostic, not an exact submitted-triangle counter. Intro 1 sphere count is 199 meshes versus 183 after engine broad-phase culling with shadows disabled.
